title: Rewards Ledger Standard: Tier-Upgrade Bonus on Re-Earned and First Upgrades (Pals Rewards and Tailwise Plus)
content:
For **Pals Rewards and Tailwise Plus**, the earned-tier upgrade bonus is produced by one of three methods, judged from the tier-upgrade bonus entries on the membership's rewards ledger. The figures used are the tier-upgrade bonus of the tier being applied — 200 points for Pals Rewards Insider, 500 points for Pals Rewards VIP — and that tier's qualifying spend threshold — $250.00 for Pals Rewards Insider, $750.00 for Pals Rewards VIP.

**1. Re-earning.** A membership whose rewards ledger carries, dated in the last 24 months, a tier-upgrade bonus entry equal to the bonus of the tier being applied is re-earning that tier and receives that bonus less every tier-upgrade bonus point posted to it in the last 24 months, never below zero.

**2. First upgrade.** A membership whose ledger carries no tier-upgrade bonus entry at all is earning its first upgrade and receives that bonus plus one point for every whole dollar by which its net qualifying spend over the last 12 months exceeds the qualifying spend threshold of the tier being applied. Net qualifying spend over the last 12 months is the qualifying spend of its points-earning entries dated in the last 12 months, less that of its points-reversal entries dated in the same period; only whole dollars of the excess count, and nothing is added where the spend does not exceed the threshold.

**3. Any other membership** receives the bonus of the tier being applied unchanged.

The re-earning test is read first. Because the 24-month total of tier-upgrade bonus points includes the matching entry itself, a re-earning membership's figure comes to 0.

### Cases (hypothetical ledgers)

| Tier being applied | Tier-upgrade bonus entries on the ledger | 12-month net spend | Method | Points |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| Pals Rewards Insider | none ever | $318.60 | first upgrade | 200 plus 68 is 268 |
| Pals Rewards Insider | none ever | $250.00 | first upgrade | 200 plus 0 is 200 |
| Pals Rewards VIP | 500, dated 14 months ago | $900.00 | re-earning | 500 less 500 is 0 |
| Pals Rewards VIP | 200, dated 9 months ago | $790.00 | other | 500 |
| Pals Rewards Insider | 200, dated 30 months ago | $400.00 | other | 200 |
